instruction: Search for March 1, 2024 papers on HuggingFace's daily papers page and add at least one more paper entry to the document with all required fields (Title, Authors, Abstract, Arxiv PDF).

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(1); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding papers to docx. Original has 8 non-empty paragraphs (2 papers × 4 fields each). Adding 1 paper = 4 more paragraphs. Expected: at least 12 paragraphs (8 + 4). Verified source has 8 paragraphs.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only verifies paragraph count (quantity), not content quality or field presence
Instruction explicitly requires 'all required fields (Title, Authors, Abstract, Arxiv PDF)' but evaluator does not verify these fields exist or are correctly formatted
User could add 4 paragraphs of random text and pass verification, even without valid paper data
No validation that added paragraphs actually contain structured paper information
Cannot distinguish between valid paper entries and junk content
Semantic mismatch: instruction requires adding structured paper entries with specific fields, but evaluator reduces this to a simple paragraph count threshold
No partial credit logic for partially complete papers (e.g., 2 fields present instead of 4)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Parse document structure to verify each paper entry has all 4 required fields (Title, Authors, Abstract, Arxiv PDF)
Use pattern matching or field detection to ensure added content follows paper entry format
Verify that new paragraphs contain meaningful content (not just empty/junk text)
Consider using docx paragraph styles or formatting to identify paper field sections
Add partial credit scoring: 0.25 per valid field in the new paper entry
Check that added content includes arxiv.org links for the PDF field
